title: O. Vincent Haleck
vital_facts: Missionary to the Samoa Apia Mission, 1968-1970
Married Peggy Ann Cameron 1972; Provo Utah Temple; three children
Bacherlor's Degree in Advertising and Marketing from BYU
Operated family-owned food services business in American Samoa
High Councilor, Bishop, Stake President, Patriarch,
President of the Samoa Apia Mission, 2008-2011
Second Quorum of the Seventy 2011 - present
